repos.name: FlashML-org/FreeToken
repos.description: FreeToken brings datacenter-scale model serving to your desktop. Run massive models locally, fast and efficiently.

tweet.text:
UC Berkeley open-sourced an inference engine that runs a 284B model on a single 32GB GPU at 22 tokens/s 🔥

It’s called FreeToken. A mixture-of-experts (MoE) model uses only a few of its experts to generate each token. 

FreeToken keeps recently used experts on the GPU and holds the rest in system RAM.

It splits the work between the CPU and GPU based on how fast data can move between them. 

The team reports 2–4× faster MoE inference than Ollama.

Here’s what they measured:

> Qwen3.6-35B → 39.3 tokens/s on 8GB of VRAM  
> DeepSeek-V4-Flash 284B → 22 tokens/s on 32GB  
> GLM-5.2 753B → 14.9 tokens/s on 96GB  

While processing a prompt, FreeToken loads one full layer while the previous one runs. 

It can reuse cached work after edits to tool calls or reasoning, and shift VRAM between experts and the KV cache without restarting or reloading the model.

It supports MXFP4, NVFP4, FP8, BF16 and GGUF weights. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs let you use it with Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode.

Runs on RTX 30, 40 and 50 series GPUs, from laptops to workstations. Apache 2.0 license, 17K+ GitHub stars.

repos.name: ever-co/ever-gauzy
repos.description: Ever® Gauzy™ - Open Business Management Platform (ERP/CRM/HRM/ATS/PM) - https://gauzy.co

tweet.text:
CRM、招聘、人事、库存、项目管理、工时、开票——这些难道还得分头折腾？Ever Gauzy 这套开源业务管理平台，就是想把团队日常运营收进一个系统里。

技术栈走的是 Angular + NestJS，多租户支持，Docker 或 Kubernetes 都能自托管，云服务也有得选。生产环境更推荐 PostgreSQL，MySQL 同样能用；SQLite 留给演示和测试正合适。

项目采用 AGPL-3.0 协议，改完再对外提供服务的话，开源义务得留个心眼。

咨询、外包这类小团队，想把客户、项目、工时、账单统一管起来的，可以试试。但它还替代不了专业 SaaS，财务深度和本地合规这些，仍得单独评估。

repos.name: erkamyaman/rea-games
repos.description: Reverse-engineer any game, rebuild it in any engine (web, Rust, Godot) and prove the rebuild plays the same, frame by frame. Behavior specs in the open GAME.md format.

tweet.text:
UNREAL STUFF... After REA, now we have REA-Games. 🤯🎮

Cooked by the same developer behind rust-anything. It lets AI reverse-engineer games, rebuild them in another engine, and verify that the remake behaves like the original.

Here's how it works:

~ Records the original game's inputs, random numbers and game state.
~ Creates a detailed GAME.md spec of the game's mechanics. 
~ Rebuilds the game in another engine, like Godot, Rust/Bevy or the web.
~ Replays the same inputs and compares the recorded states.
~ Finds exactly where the remake behaves differently.

The creator has already tested it on 2048, Chrome Dino, Canvas Bird and Blocks, with hundreds of thousands of recorded inputs and frames matching across the rebuilds.

Yesterday's science fiction is today's reality :)
